findings.message: This is a visual concept of a quadruped robot dog rebuilt from the image. Parts are shapes, not sourced products; wiring, power, fit and function were not checked
Sizes are estimated from the image (about 349 x 394 x 553 mm overall)
15 internal parts are typical for a quadruped robot dog, inferred rather than seen in the image; their type, size and placement are guesses

concept.summary: A grey four-legged robot dog: long rounded torso, black sensor face with a ribbed lidar dome under the chin, aluminium-capped hip and thigh actuators, curved thighs and slim shins on black rubber feet.
